result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. `reports` compiles cleanly, but I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The export now builds the entry list from the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is the same helper that writes the loose text files. It then reads that file and adds it to the zip.

With the default config the names and order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written afterwards as before, so it no longer gets skipped when the first zip fails.

Other code still hard-codes the old names, and I left it alone: `LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–284) reads `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` and the other default file names, and `ReportFileExporter.java` builds the HTML links to the `data/text` files. They aren't part of the zip export.
